reviewMethod: Source-code inspection + simulation output review. No browser rendering or screen-reader testing performed — all findings from code-level analysis.

greeting.text: Hi, I'm May — your CMA Part 1 practice coach.
greeting.toneCheck: Professional but warm. No patronizing language. Sets clear expectations.

chooseFromRoll.buttonText: Yes — choose my name from the roll

enrollNew.buttonText: No — enroll me as a new student

primaryActions.rating: PASS — both actions clearly labeled and mutually exclusive

studentRoll.maskingWorks: Verified via simulation: all 8 synthetic students masked in roll UI

buttonLabels.notes: All onboarding and tutoring buttons use descriptive text labels. Exam onboarding buttons state clear choices ('Yes — I have an exam scheduled' etc.). No icon-only buttons found.
buttonLabels.improvementsSuggested: Consider aria-label attributes on student-row divs for screen-reader identification.

keyboardNavigation.notes: Student selection uses onclick on divs without tabIndex or onkeydown handlers. Keyboard-only users cannot select from the roll. All other buttons are native <button> elements and are keyboard-reachable.
keyboardNavigation.improvementsSuggested: Add tabIndex='0' and onkeydown (Enter/Space) handlers to .may-student-row divs.

focusOrder.notes: Logical DOM-based focus order: greeting → student roll → tutoring buttons → chat input. Onboarding buttons appear before main content.

colorContrast.notes: Color contrast ratios not verified in this review. Band colors (green/red/amber) on readiness cards should be checked against WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text).

screenReader.notes: No screen-reader testing performed. aria-live regions not present for May's dynamic chat updates.

welcomeBackOverview.structure: Personalized welcome → Positive trend detection → Strengths + opportunities → Next best action → Pre-production disclaimer
welcomeBackOverview.visualSeparation: Each section rendered as separate paragraphs. Trends use emoji markers (📈).
welcomeBackOverview.sparseDataFallback: Safe fallback message when insufficient data: 'Keep building your practice history — I'll have more insights after a few more sessions.'

examPlanUI.promptText: Do you already have a CMA exam scheduled?
examPlanUI.stressLevel: LOW — offers 'No' and 'Planning' paths. Uses encouraging tone regardless of answer.
examPlanUI.daysUntilExamMessage: Encouraging, time-appropriate. No urgency or pressure language.

noPredictionLanguage.rating: PASS — all banned phrases absent from UI and chat output

changesMade: NONE — UI/accessibility review passed at current state. Narrow polish deferred to S119 if needed.

recommendations.keyboardNavigation: Add tabIndex and onkeydown to student-row divs (low effort, high impact)
recommendations.ariaLabels: Add aria-label to onboarding buttons and student rows (low effort, medium impact)
recommendations.colorContrast: Verify readiness badge colors against WCAG AA (low effort, medium impact)
recommendations.mobileResponsive: Test on 320px viewport for student roll layout (renders inline via CSS flex, likely OK)
recommendations.severityDistribution: NO CRITICAL BLOCKERS — all findings are polish-level

verdict: UI/ACCESSIBILITY PASS — May onboarding is clear, privacy-safe, and inviting. Keyboard navigation on student rows is the primary gap; non-blocking polish item for S119.
